article.title: MWC matchup features UNLV squaring off against Air Force
article.linkText: MWC matchup features UNLV squaring off against Air Force
article.story: UNLV (4-2) at Air Force (4-1), Oct. 17 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: UNLV by 3. Against the spread: UNLV 4-2, Air Force 3-2. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats UNLV Offense Overall: 369.7 yards per game (91st in FBS) Passing: 191.5 yards per game (104th) Rushing: 178.2 yards per game (53rd) Scoring: 23.0 points per game (101st) UNLV Defense Overall: 370.2 yards per game (89th in FBS) Passing: 228.8 yards per game (95th) Rushing: 141.3 yards per game (68th) Scoring: 20.8 points per game (47th) Air Force Offense Overall: 400.0 yards per game (66th in FBS) Passing: 74.4 yards per game (138th) Rushing: 325.6 yards per game (2nd) Scoring: 28.8 points per game (71st) Air Force Defense Overall: 279.6 yards per game (17th in FBS) Passing: 157.6 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 122.0 yards per game (43rd) Scoring: 17.4 points per game (27th) UNLV is 90th in third down percentage, converting 37.4% of the time. Air Force ranks 9th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 27.6%. UNLV ranks 118th in the FBS averaging 71.5 penalty yards per game, compared to Air Force's 27th-ranked 45.8 per-game average. UNLV is 128th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 70.6% of trips. Air Force's red zone defense ranks 37th at 76.9%. UNLV is 56th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 30:35, compared to Air Force's 2nd-ranked average of 36:36. Team leaders UNLV Passing: Jackson Arnold, 1,140 yards, 8 TDs, 1 INT, 58.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jai'Den Thomas, 495 yards on 95 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tastean Reddicks, 280 yards on 15 catches, 2 TDs Air Force Passing: Liam Szarka, 296 yards, 1 TD, 4 INTs, 50.0 completion percentage Rushing: Szarka, 391 yards on 92 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Simon Kibbee, 103 yards on 6 catches, 0 TDs Last game UNLV won 13-7 over North Dakota State on Oct. 10. Arnold led UNLV with 77 yards on 8-of-16 passing (50.0%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 19 times for 60 yards. Thomas carried the ball 22 times for 112 yards, adding two receptions for seven yards. Kayden McGee recorded 43 yards on three catches. Air Force beat Northern Illinois 28-7 on Oct. 10. Owen Allen carried the ball 13 times for 100 yards and scored two touchdowns. Next game UNLV hosts Northern Illinois on Oct. 31. Air Force plays at Wyoming on Oct. 23.
